name: Viñales Valley
description: Viñales Valley is a broad, flat-floored basin in western Cuba's Pinar del Río Province, ringed by the Sierra de los Órganos mountains. Steep, rounded limestone outcrops rise abruptly from red-soil fields, where farmers still grow tobacco with traditional methods. Small villages and farmhouses of local vernacular design dot the 132-square-kilometre landscape, which makes it a favourite for walking and horseback rides.
